entry.title: Senate Republicans Release Revised Clarity Act Ahead of September 15 Vote
entry.summary: The draft adds registration requirements for controlled trading protocols and leaves its ethics provisions largely unchanged.

entry.title: DeepSeek's New Model Nearly Matches GPT-6 Astra on Design—at 1.4% of the Cost
entry.summary: OpenDesign put 13 AI models through the same design tasks. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash landed a point and a half behind GPT-6 Astra and roughly 70 times cheaper.

entry.title: AI Agents Just Slashed the Cost of a Quantum Attack on Bitcoin
entry.summary: The ECDSA.Fail challenge cut a resource benchmark for one component of a potential quantum attack by 86%.

entry.title: Coinbase Wallet Rebrands to Chase 'Anything, Anywhere' Trading as Robinhood Chain Heats Up
entry.summary: Head of Product Ryan Kass says the return to Coinbase Wallet reflects a broader trading strategy, with the self-custody app serving as a testing ground for new assets and experiences.

entry.title: Bitcoin Rally Cools, But a Golden Cross Is Coming
entry.summary: Bitcoin couldn't escape today's inflation-driven selloff, but a bearish pattern on its chart is about to flip for the first time since November.

entry.title: Banks Have Minutes, Not Weeks, to Fix Flaws as AI Speeds Up Attacks: BIS
entry.summary: The Bank for International Settlements says routine patching schedules are increasingly inadequate and cites guidance urging banks to accept planned downtime for urgent fixes.

entry.title: This Guy Cloned Sam Altman, Elon Musk, and Zuckerberg Into AI Bots. They Immediately Started Fighting
entry.summary: Kun Chen built chatbot versions of four AI CEOs on SpaceXAI's new Grok Bot templates, locked them in one chat, and told them to debate the AI race until they agreed on something.

entry.title: Anthropic Discloses Fourth Claude Hacking Incident as Debate Around Regulation Grows
entry.summary: The company now says attacks during security tests exposed model behavior failures, after initially emphasizing errors in its testing infrastructure.

entry.title: Bitcoin at $400K by 2030 Still 'Reasonable Target': Coinbase CEO
entry.summary: Brian Armstrong argues the bottom is in, a year into the downturn, with the next halving roughly 18 months out.

entry.title: Morning Minute: Hunter Biden’s LAPTOP Crashes
entry.summary: The meme coin plunged on its debut, as recent alt leaders and many onchain darlings slipped in a nasty day for crypto.

entry.title: Nasdaq Invests $100M in Kraken Parent Payward at $21B Valuation
entry.summary: Deutsche Börse's April stake implied a $13.3 billion valuation. Five months on, Nasdaq is paying at $21 billion.

entry.title: Vitalik Buterin Pushes Ethereum Plan to Slash Quantum-Safe Privacy Costs
entry.summary: Buterin wants EIP-8288 in I-star, the upgrade after Hegota, and adopting it would make RISC-V Ethereum's canonical instruction set.

entry.title: Bitcoin Wallet Maker Trezor Says Hackers Breached Its Email Provider
entry.summary: The hardware wallet maker said a fake security alert claimed a hardware flaw could expose users’ recovery phrases.

entry.title: AI Is Solving Math's Best Problems Faster Than They Can Be Replaced, Terence Tao Warns
entry.summary: The Fields medalist points to a real race between OpenAI and Anthropic as proof: AI can now flatten a hard problem the moment someone starts working on it.

entry.title: Crypto, Banks Take Clarity Act Lobbying Fight to Senators' Home States
entry.summary: Crypto advocates and community bankers are targeting lawmakers in their home states as the Senate prepares for a September 15 procedural vote.

entry.title: Apple Unveils Redesigned Siri AI and A20 Pro Chip as CEO John Ternus Makes Debut
entry.summary: The company's first fall keynote under new leadership paired a Gemini-powered Siri overhaul with Apple's first 2-nanometer chip, plus a $1,999 foldable iPhone that won't ship until October.

entry.title: Secret Service Freezes $52.8 Million in Crypto Tied to Telegram Bazaar Behind Global Scams
entry.summary: Blockchain sleuths at Elliptic traced the money, Treasury sanctioned the marketplace, and Xinbi—which ran $24 billion through a Telegram scam bazaar—called the freeze unfair.

entry.title: While Bitcoin Devs Debate Next Moves, IonQ Unveils Superion 256 Quantum Computer
entry.summary: The company has built its first chips and begun testing prototypes as it seeks to manufacture quantum computers in larger quantities.

entry.title: What Is LAPTOP? Hunter Biden's Meme Coin Targeting TRUMP Holders
entry.summary: The LAPTOP token launched on Base in September 2026, peaked two minutes later, and shed almost all of its value the same day.

entry.title: Mexican Musician and Family Killed Over Bitcoin Cold Wallet Believed to Hold Millions
entry.summary: Mexican prosecutors allege suspects targeted Camilo Séptimo keyboardist Jonathan Meléndez and his family while searching for a cold wallet they believed contained millions in Bitcoin.

entry.title: Hunter Biden's LAPTOP Meme Coin Crashes 99% on Debut
entry.summary: LAPTOP hit a $190.81 peak within minutes of launching on Base, then shed roughly 99% as thin liquidity met a wave of selling.

entry.title: Prediction Markets Abandon Cheap Oil as Brent Passes $100
entry.summary: Myriad's $120 side overtook $55 at the start of September, while Polymarket puts WTI reaching $100 this month at 59%.

entry.title: Consensys Is Splitting in Two as MetaMask Goes Its Own Way
entry.summary: Consensys Software Inc. will become MetaMask, while a newly formed Consensys will take over the firm's Ethereum protocols and institutional blockchain infrastructure business.

entry.title: German Finance Ministry Drafts 25% Tax on Crypto Gains From 2027
entry.summary: Anything bought before 2027 keeps the twelve-month exemption, so the change lands only on Germany's future crypto buyers.

entry.title: Morning Minute: Venice’s VVV Token Soars After OpenAI Dispute
entry.summary: Concerns over frontier AI labs stealing user data has driven demand for private inference (or at least tokens tied to private inference).

entry.title: UK Crime Agency Warns of 'Innovative Use' of Crypto by Launderers
entry.summary: The agency ranks cryptoassets third among nine economic crime priorities, and says it wants to generate its own targets.

entry.title: Mexico Seizes 300 Crypto Mining Rigs Wired Into a Hydroelectric Dam
entry.summary: Forensic accountants are tracing who paid for the mining hardware, and money laundering has not been ruled out.

entry.title: Jack Dorsey's Block Applies for Bank Charter to Custody Bitcoin
entry.summary: Builders Bank would consolidate custody work Block now runs under more than 50 state money transmitter licenses.

entry.title: OpenAI Says It Solved a $1M Math Problem. A Rival Mathematician Says He Did It First
entry.summary: NYU's Tristan Buckmaster accuses OpenAI's Sébastien Bubeck of racing to claim credit for a Navier-Stokes proof after learning about his unpublished work with Anthropic's Levent Alpöge.

entry.title: $47M Still Missing After Liquid Hack as Blockstream Bargains With 'White Hats'
entry.summary: The hackers have returned 3,400 of the roughly 4,000 BTC drained from the sidechain, but about 600 BTC remains outstanding—and some doubt the actors' "white hat" claims.

entry.title: Bitcoin Holds, Wall Street Stalls as Oil Shock Revives Fed Hike Bets
entry.summary: Bitcoin is defending its golden zone support while the S&P 500 grinds inside its tightest range yet, both waiting on Friday's inflation report before the Fed's September 16 rate call.

entry.title: Visa Taps Onchain Lending to Finance Stablecoin Card Programs
entry.summary: The payment processor giant is pairing payment settlement data with blockchain lending tools to help fintechs and stablecoin-linked card programs access working capital.

entry.title: Strive Buys $109 Million in Bitcoin, Pushes Preferred Stock Toward $1 Billion
entry.summary: The Vivek Ramaswamy-founded asset manager added 1,375 BTC last week, its third straight week of 5%-plus growth.

entry.title: Cronos Erased Two Hours of Transactions to Reverse $111 Million DeFi Exploit
entry.summary: The rollback reversed legitimate activity alongside the attack, while $9.19 million remains unrecovered, according to Cronos.

entry.title: US Police Fear Meta Glasses Are Watching Them Back: Report
entry.summary: Memos from the NYPD to Homeland Security warn the devices could be used for covert filming inside jails and police facilities.
